newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police hunt hostage takers, one injured.
newsitem.headline: German police hunt hostage takers, one injured.

text.p: German police were hunting 10 armed assailants who took eight Asians hostage and seriously injured a woman among them in the western town of Neuss early on Tuesday.

The gang seized the Asians, believed by police to be from Laos, in a house and demanded a ransom of tens of thousands of marks. One of the captives phoned a relative who alerted the police, a police spokesman in Duesseldorf said.

A large contingent of police sealed off the area and surrounded the house, but the armed assailants escaped without trace, police said. It was not clear what sort of weapons they had or how the woman was injured.
